courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 盾尾空隙同步灌漿
related.transfer: 可遷移「始發到達控制體」與「反力架與暫態傳力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；盾尾空隙同步灌漿的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Launch and reception control volumes" and "Reaction frame and temporary load paths" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Synchronous tail-void grouting must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換；盾尾空隙同步灌漿則以以環隙體積、漿體時變行為與環片浮力驗證盾尾背填為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths; Synchronous tail-void grouting centres on verify tail-void backfill through annular volume, time-dependent grout and lining buoyancy, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「始發到達控制體」與「理論環隙與超挖」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到盾尾空隙同步灌漿，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「早齡剛度與荷載接替」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Launch and reception control volumes” and “Theoretical annulus and overbreak”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Synchronous tail-void grouting, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Early stiffness and load transfer", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 潛盾掘進導向控制
related.transfer: 可遷移「始發到達控制體」與「反力架與暫態傳力」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；潛盾掘進導向控制的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Launch and reception control volumes" and "Reaction frame and temporary load paths" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of TBM alignment guidance and control must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換；潛盾掘進導向控制則以把坐標基準、機身姿態與環片幾何連成可獨立查核的導航鏈為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths; TBM alignment guidance and control centres on link coordinate datum, machine attitude and ring geometry in an independently checkable navigation chain, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「始發到達控制體」與「控制網與坐標基準」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到潛盾掘進導向控制，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「尾隙與機器環片相對位移」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Launch and reception control volumes” and “Control networks and coordinate datum”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to TBM alignment guidance and control, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Relative machine-ring clearance", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 潛盾發進與到達端止水
history.titleEn: Water sealing at shield launch and reception
history.text: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以始發到達介面、地層水文和暫態受力驗證止水轉換需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why verify launch and reception sealing transitions through interfaces, hydrogeology and temporary load paths requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
